Dim sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu, UstMargin, solMargin, sagMargin, satiryuksekligi
Dim siraNo, satirBaslangic
Dim xCizgi, Grid
Sub PrintForm()
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	solMargin = 8
	sagMargin = SayfaBoyu - 8
	UstMargin = 8
	satiryuksekligi = 4.5

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	Call Alanlar()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Fiyat Listesi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "LANDSCAPE")

	satirSonu = sayfaEni - 12
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 51

	satirSayisi_tableT = STOK48T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For I = 1 To satirSayisi_tableT
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, I)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	SuAn = Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun) & " " & Doc.Saat(5)
	For i = 1 to pe1.GetPageCount()
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 1, sagMargin - 30, 5, 30, "Sayfa " & i & " / " & pe1.GetPageCount())
		res = pe1.Write(pe1.getTop + satirYuksekligi, pe1.GetLeft, 5, 30, SuAn)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If logo <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Picture(ustMargin + 1, solMargin + 1, 15, 35, logo, 18)
	End If
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 14)
	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.write(18, 10, 15, SayfaBoyu - 30, "Fiyat Listesi")

	res = pe1.setbold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
'*******************
	BBasla = UstMargin + 20
	SatirAra = 5

	FisNo = STOK48E.EVRAKNO(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , solMargin + 1, 6, 30, "Liste No")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla , 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & trim(FisNo))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, solMargin + 1, 6, 28, "Açýklama")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + SatirAra, 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & STOK48E.NOTES(1))
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, solMargin + 1, 6, 28, "Son Kayýt Tarihi")		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & doc.StrToNorDate(STOK48E.REF_TARIH_1))
	'res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	'res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, solMargin + 1, 6, 30, "Önceki Liste Tarihi")		
	'res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	'res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & doc.StrToNorDate(GetOncekiListeTarihi))

	CHKodu = STOK48E.REF_CHKODU
	CH_GK5 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","GK_5",CHKodu,-1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.write(45, 220, 6, 50, "Kur riski var mý? : " & CH_GK5)		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	'res = pe1.write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, solMargin + 170, 6, 50, "Kur Riski : " & KurRiski)		
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	'res = pe1.write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, 41, 6, SayfaEni - 70, ": " & doc.StrToNorDate(GetOncekiListeTarihi))

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
'***********************		
	ReDim xCizgi(0)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 9)
	Sol = solMargin + 1
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
			res = pe1.write(satirBaslangic - 9, Sol, 10, SutunGenisligi - 2 , Baslik)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
		xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)) = Sol - 1
		Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)+1)
	Next
	Redim Preserve xCizgi(uBound(xCizgi)-1)

	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
'yatay çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
'	res = pe1.Line(28, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 10, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 1, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)

	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 0
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
	End If

	siraNo = siraNo + 1
	satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi
	
	Musteri	 = STOK48E.REF_CHKODU
	Vade = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00","B_DEFAULT_VADEGUN",Musteri,"")	
	
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = solMargin + 1
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		if Left(DegiskenAdi, 1) <> "_" Then
			Degisken = STOK48T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
		Else
			OFiyatArray = GetOFiyatArray(STOK48T.KOD(satirNo), STOK48E.REF_CHKODU, STOK48E.REF_TARIH_1)
			if DegiskenAdi = "_OFIYAT" Then
				Degisken = OFiyatArray(0)
			Elseif DegiskenAdi = "_OPARABIRIMI" Then
				Degisken = OFiyatArray(1)
			Elseif DegiskenAdi = "_VADE" Then
				Degisken = Vade
			Elseif DegiskenAdi = "_RISK" Then
				CHKodu = STOK48E.REF_CHKODU
				CHParaBirimi = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00","DEFAULTKUR",CHKodu,"")
				if trim(CHParaBirimi) = "USD" or trim(CHParaBirimi) = "EUR" or trim(CHParaBirimi) = "GBP" then
					KurRiski = "Evet"
				Else   		
					KurRiski = "Hayýr"
			End if
			Degisken = KurRiski

			Elseif DegiskenAdi = "_FARK" Then
				YeniFiyat = STOK48T.PRICE(satirNo)
				EskiFiyat = OFiyatArray(0)
				Degisken = (Doc.Div(YeniFiyat, EskiFiyat) - 1) * 100
			End if
		End if
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.box(8, solMargin, satirSonu-3, sagMargin - solMargin)

'dikey çizgiler
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	For i = 0 To UBound(xCizgi) - 1
		LineX = xCizgi(i)
		res = pe1.Line(satirBaslangic - 10, LineX, satirSonu - satirBaslangic + 15, 0)
	Next
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(11,6)
	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "VR_R2"
	Grid(2,0) = "PRICE"
	Grid(3,0) = "_OFIYAT"
	Grid(4,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_UNIT"
	Grid(6,0) = "_FARK"
	Grid(7,0) = "KRI_TARIH_1"
	Grid(8,0) = "KRI_TARIH_2"
	Grid(9,0) = "_VADE"
	Grid(10,0) = "REF_NOTES"


	Grid(0,1) = 50
	Grid(1,1) = 65
	Grid(2,1) = 15
	Grid(3,1) = 15
	Grid(4,1) = 10
	Grid(5,1) = 10
	Grid(6,1) = 15
	Grid(7,1) = 18
	Grid(8,1) = 18
	Grid(9,1) = 10
	Grid(10,1) = 50


	Grid(0,2) = "Stok Kodu"
	Grid(1,2) = "Stok Adý"
	Grid(2,2) = "Fiyat"
	Grid(3,2) = "Ö Fiyat"
	Grid(4,2) = "PB"
	Grid(5,2) = "Brm"
	Grid(6,2) = "Deðiþim%"
	Grid(7,2) = "Baþlangýç Tr."
	Grid(8,2) = "Bitiþ Tr."
	Grid(9,2) = "Vade"
	Grid(10,2) = "Not"

	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "D"
	Grid(8,4) = "D"
	Grid(9,4) = "C"
	Grid(10,4) = "C"

	Grid(2,6) = 4
	Grid(3,6) = 4
	Grid(6,6) = 1
End Sub
Sub Normal(pe1)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	res = pe1.setitalic(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.2)
	res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
	res = pe1.setrotation(0)
	res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
	res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("left")
End Sub
Function GetOFiyatArray(StokKodu, CHKodu, Tarih)
	ReDim FiyatArray(1)
	FiyatArray(0) = 0
	FiyatArray(1) = ""
	QStr = "REF_CHKODU='"+CHKodu+"'&KOD='"+StokKodu+"'&REF_TARIH_1<'"+Tarih+"'"
	Set S48T = Doc.Select1("STOK48T_FORM1", "STOK48T", QStr, "<REF_TARIH_1", 1)
	if S48T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		FiyatArray(0) = S48T.PRICE(1)
		FiyatArray(1) = S48T.PRICEUNIT(1)
	End if
	GetOFiyatArray = FiyatArray
End Function
Function GetOncekiListeTarihi()
	if STOK48T.GetRowCount = 0 Then Exit Function
	StokKodu = STOK48T.KOD(1)
	CHKodu = STOK48E.REF_CHKODU
	Tarih = STOK48E.REF_TARIH_1

	QStr = "REF_CHKODU='"+CHKodu+"'&KOD='"+StokKodu+"'&REF_TARIH_1<'"+Tarih+"'"
	Set S48T = Doc.Select1("STOK48T_FORM1", "STOK48T", QStr, "<REF_TARIH_1", 1)
	if S48T.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
		GetOncekiListeTarihi = S48T.REF_TARIH_1(1)
	End if
End Function

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 140
	sayfaEni = 215
	UstMargin = 56
	SolMargin = 11
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
'	satirBaslangic = 77.5
	satirBaslangic = 94

	satirsonu = satirbaslangic + satiryuksekligi * 5
	toplamtutar=0
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	
'	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage_P(33)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
'	res = pe1.Open(0, "SEVK ÝRSALÝYESÝ",  Sayfaeni,Sayfaboyu,"")

	res = pe1.Open(0, "SEVK ÝRSALÝYESÝ",  Sayfaboyu,Sayfaeni,"")


	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK60T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S60T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set S60 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK60T")
	S60T.CopyTable(S60)
	S60T.SafePack
	S60T.GroupBy("KOD")

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = S60T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	chkod=STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chad=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, "")
	chad2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, "")
	chadres1=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, "")
	chadres2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, "")
	chadres3=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, "")
	chvergidairesi = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, "")
	chvergino = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, "")
	tarih=doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarihi = doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH(1))
	teslimatyeri1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	teslimatyeri2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	teslimatyeri3 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	unvan1=STOK60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1
	unvan2=STOK60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_2

' --------- 8.NSN.2010 --------------------------------------------------
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5 + satiryuksekligi, 22, satiryuksekligi, 150, trim(chadres1) & " " & trim(chadres2) & " " & chadres3)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5 + satiryuksekligi, 130, satiryuksekligi, 80, trim(teslimatyeri1))
' 	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5 + satiryuksekligi*2, 130, satiryuksekligi,80 ,trim(teslimatyeri2) & " " & teslimatyeri3)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, 22, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(chad) & " " & chad2)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, 130, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(unvan1) & " " &  unvan2)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5 + satiryuksekligi*3, 41, satiryuksekligi, 70, chvergidairesi & "/" & chvergino)
'	res=pe1.write(30,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, tarih)
'	res=pe1.write(39,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, sevktarihi)
' -----------------------------------------------------------------------
	xxUst = 68
	res=pe1.write(xxUst, 22, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(chad) & " " & chad2)
	res=pe1.write(xxUst, 130, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(unvan1) & " " &  unvan2)
	res=pe1.write(xxUst+satiryuksekligi, 22, satiryuksekligi, 150, trim(chadres1) & " " & trim(chadres2) & " " & chadres3)
	res=pe1.write(xxUst+satiryuksekligi, 130, satiryuksekligi, 80, trim(teslimatyeri1))
 	res=pe1.write(xxUst + satiryuksekligi*2, 130, satiryuksekligi,80 ,trim(teslimatyeri2) & " " & teslimatyeri3)
	res=pe1.write((xxUst+12), 41, satiryuksekligi, 70, chvergidairesi & "/" & chvergino)
	res=pe1.write(46,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, tarih)
	res=pe1.write(56,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, sevktarihi)

End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	
	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
	Dim satirpozr
'		sol = solmargin-10
		sol = solmargin-1

msgbox STOK60T.ALLOC_EVRAKNO(satirNo) &"  -  "& STOK60T.ALLOC_EVRAKTYPE(satirNo) &"  -  "& STOK60T.ALLOC_SYSSTATUS(satirNo) &"  -  "& STOK60T.ALLOC_NONMOVABL(satirNo) 

		If trim(S60T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi

			End If
		End If		
		
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(S60T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				
				End If
				if DegiskenAdi="SF_SF_UNIT" then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				end if 
				
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				Next
	End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	Notlar = STOK60E.NOTES_1(1)
	Notlar5 = STOK60E.NOTES_4(1)
	Nakliye = STOK60E.BOX1_1(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirbaslangic + satiryuksekligi*7.5, solmargin + 10, satiryuksekligi, 150, Notlar)
	res = pe1.write(satirbaslangic + satiryuksekligi*9, 35, satiryuksekligi, 50, Nakliye)
	res = pe1.write(120, 35, satiryuksekligi, 50, Notlar5)
End Sub

End Sub

	res=pe1.write(56,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, sevktarihi)
' -----------------------------------------------------------


End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
	
	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
	Dim satirpozr
'		sol = solmargin-10
		sol = solmargin-1

		If trim(S61T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi

			End If
		End If		
		
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				Degisken = trim(cstr(S61T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				
				End If
				if DegiskenAdi="SF_SF_UNIT" then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				end if 
				
				res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				Next
	End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	Notlar = STOK60E.NOTES_1(1)
	Notlar5 = STOK60E.NOTES_4(1)
	Nakliye = STOK60E.BOX1_1(1)
	res = pe1.write(satirbaslangic + satiryuksekligi*7.5, solmargin + 10, satiryuksekligi, 150, Notlar)
	res = pe1.write(satirbaslangic + satiryuksekligi*9, 35, satiryuksekligi, 50, Nakliye)
	res = pe1.write(120, 35, satiryuksekligi, 50, Notlar5)
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8,6)

	Grid(0,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(2,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"

	Grid(0,1) = 63
	Grid(1,1) = 79
	Grid(2,1) = 25
	Grid(3,1) = 25
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "N"
	Grid(3,4) = "C"
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 140
	sayfaEni = 215
	UstMargin = 56
	SolMargin = 11
	satiryuksekligi = 4.3
'	satirBaslangic = 77.5
	satirBaslangic = 94

	satirsonu = satirbaslangic + satiryuksekligi * 5
	toplamtutar=0
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	
'	res = pe1.SetConsolePrintOpt(1)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetLinesPerPage_P(33)
'	res = pe1.ConsoleOutput_SetCharsPerInch(17)
'	res = pe1.Open(0, "SEVK ÝRSALÝYESÝ",  Sayfaeni,Sayfaboyu,"LANDSCAPE")
	res = pe1.Open(0, "SEVK ÝRSALÝYESÝ",  Sayfaboyu, Sayfaeni,"")

	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=STOK61T", "TMPCOPY"
	Set S61T = Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set S60 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK61T")
	S61T.CopyTable(S60)
	S61T.SafePack
	S61T.GroupBy("KOD")

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	satirSayisi = S61T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	res=pe1.selectfont("arial",9)
			
	chkod=STOK60E.CH_KODU(1)
	chad=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "AD", chkod, "")
	chad2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "NAME2", chkod, "")
	chadres1=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_1", chkod, "")
	chadres2=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_2", chkod, "")
	chadres3=doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "ADRES_3", chkod, "")
	chvergidairesi = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGIDAIRESI", chkod, "")
	chvergino = doc.getdbfieldvalue("CARI00", "VERGINO", chkod, "")
	tarih=doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.TARIH(1))
	sevktarihi = doc.strtonordate(STOK60E.RSEVKTARIH(1))
	teslimatyeri1 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_1(1)
	teslimatyeri2 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_2(1)
	teslimatyeri3 = STOK60E.SEVKADRESI_3(1)
	unvan1=STOK60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_1
	unvan2=STOK60E.SHIPTO_UNVAN_2
	
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5 + satiryuksekligi, 22, satiryuksekligi, 150, trim(chadres1) & " " & trim(chadres2) & " " & chadres3)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5 + satiryuksekligi, 130, satiryuksekligi, 80, trim(teslimatyeri1))
' 	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5 + satiryuksekligi*2, 130, satiryuksekligi,80 ,trim(teslimatyeri2) & " " & teslimatyeri3)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, 22, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(chad) & " " & chad2)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5, 130, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(unvan1) & " " &  unvan2)
'	res=pe1.write(ustmargin-5 + satiryuksekligi*3, 41, satiryuksekligi, 70, chvergidairesi & "/" & chvergino)
'	res=pe1.write(30,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, tarih)
'	res=pe1.write(39,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, sevktarihi)

' -----------------------------------------------------------
	xxUst = 68
	res=pe1.write(xxUst, 22, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(chad) & " " & chad2)
	res=pe1.write(xxUst, 130, satiryuksekligi, 100, trim(unvan1) & " " &  unvan2)
	res=pe1.write(xxUst+satiryuksekligi, 22, satiryuksekligi, 150, trim(chadres1) & " " & trim(chadres2) & " " & chadres3)
	res=pe1.write(xxUst+satiryuksekligi, 130, satiryuksekligi, 80, trim(teslimatyeri1))
 	res=pe1.write(xxUst + satiryuksekligi*2, 130, satiryuksekligi,80 ,trim(teslimatyeri2) & " " & teslimatyeri3)
	res=pe1.write((xxUst+12), 41, satiryuksekligi, 70, chvergidairesi & "/" & chvergino)
	res=pe1.write(46,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, tarih)
	res=pe1.write(56,160, satiryuksekligi, 30, sevktarihi)
' ------------------------------------------------------------------

End Sub

Kod : 
Public SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, SolMargin, SagMargin, 	UstMargin, AltMargin, SatirYuksekligi, SatirBasla, SayfaSatirSayisi, SatirPozR
Public DisKutuGenislik, DisKutuBoyu, xSatirNo
Public Grid

Sub PrintForm()
'	SayfaBoyu = 297
'	SayfaEni  = 210

	SayfaBoyu = 210
	SayfaEni  = 297

	SolMargin = 8
	SagMargin = 8
	UstMargin = 8
	AltMargin = 8 
	SatirYuksekligi = 5
	SatirBasla= 38
	SayfaSatirSayisi= 49
	SatirPozR=0
	xSatirNo = 0
	DisKutuGenislik = SayfaEni - (SolMargin + SagMargin)
	DisKutuBoyu     = SayfaBoyu- (UstMargin + AltMargin)
	Set Pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	Res = Pe1.Open(0, "Urun Agaci", SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, "LANDSCAPE")

	res = pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",8)
	Call Alanlar()
	Call CerceveCizgiBaslik(Pe1)
	For I=1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		Call SatirYazdir(pe1, i)
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub CerceveCizgiBaslik(Pe1)
	' dýþ çerçeve
	Res = Pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	Res = Pe1.Box(UstMargin, SolMargin, DisKutuBoyu, DisKutuGenislik)
	' Logo / basliklar 
'	LogoW = 33
'	LogoH = (SatirYuksekligi*3)
	LogoW = 15
	LogoH = 15

	Logo = Trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO")))
	Res = Pe1.Nopen()
	Res = Pe1.Picture(UstMargin+1, SolMargin+1, LogoH, LogoW, Logo,0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",10)
	xSol = Solmargin+LogoW+5
	Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+SatirYuksekligi,   xSol,    SatirYuksekligi, 30, "Mamul Ürün Kodu")
	Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+SatirYuksekligi,   xSol+30, SatirYuksekligi, 100, ": "&" "&Trim(BOMU01E.MAMULCODE))
	Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+SatirYuksekligi,   xSol+130, SatirYuksekligi, 100, "ÇOK SEVÝYELÝ ÜRÜN AÐACI")
	Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+2*SatirYuksekligi, xSol,    SatirYuksekligi, 30, "Mamul Miktarý")
	Res = Pe1.Write(UstMargin+2*SatirYuksekligi, xSol+30, SatirYuksekligi, 100, ": "&" "&Trim(BOMU01E.MAMULMIKTAR))
	res = pe1.SelectFont("ARIAL",8)
' Basliklar va baþlýk yatay-dikey çizgileri
	Res = Pe1.Line(Pe1.GetTop()+2*SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin, 0, DisKutuGenislik)
' QQ
	xYukseklik = 174
	xSol = SolMargin 
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		KolonGenisligi = Grid(i, 1) 
		xHeader = Grid(i, 2)
	 	Res = Pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Trim(xHeader)<>"" Then
			Res = Pe1.Line(Pe1.getTop, xSol, xYukseklik, 0)	
		End If
		xSol = xSol + KolonGenisligi
	Next	
	xUst = Pe1.GetTop()
	xSol = SolMargin + 1
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid, 1)
		KolonGenisligi = Grid(i, 1) 
		xBasliklar = Grid(i, 2)
	 	Res = Pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		Res = Pe1.Write(xUst, xSol, 2*SatirYukSekligi, KolonGenisligi-2, xBasliklar)	
		xSol = xSol + KolonGenisligi
	Next	
	Res = Pe1.Line(Pe1.GetTop()+2*SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin, 0, DisKutuGenislik)
	Res = Pe1.Write((SayfaBoyu-AltmArgin)+1, SolMargin+10,SatirYuksekligi, 30, "09 FRM 011/ 01")
End Sub

Sub SatirYazdir(pe1, SatirNo)
	If Trim(MULTILEVEL.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(SatirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	Degisken = ""
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = Solmargin + 1
	If SatirNo = 1 Then
		SatirPozR	= SatirBasla
	Else
		SatirPozR	= SatirPozR + SatirYuksekligi
	End If
	If xSatirNo>SayfaSatirSayisi Then
		Res = Pe1.PageBreak()
		Call CerceveCizgiBaslik(Pe1)
		Call Alanlar()
		SatirPozR	= SatirBasla
		xSatirNo = 0
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 8)
	End If
	For j=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(j,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(j,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(j,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = 4
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(j,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, SatirYuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	xSatirNo = xSatirNo+1
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8, 8)

	Grid(0, 0) = "XLEVEL"
	Grid(1, 0) = "BOMREC_SIRANO"
	Grid(2, 0) = "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE"
	Grid(3, 0) = "ACIKLAMA"
	Grid(4, 0) = "BOMREC_OPERASYON"
	Grid(5, 0) = "BOMREC_OPERASYON_IMLT01_AD"
	Grid(6, 0) = "KAYNAKMIKTART"
	Grid(7, 0) = "KAYNAK_BIRIM"

	Grid(0, 1) = 11
	Grid(1, 1) = 10
	Grid(2, 1) = 40
	Grid(3, 1) = 70
	Grid(4, 1) = 20
	Grid(5, 1) = 70
	Grid(6, 1) = 20
	Grid(7, 1) = 15

	Grid(0, 2) = "Seviye"
	Grid(1, 2) = "Sýra No"
	Grid(2, 2) = "Kaynak Kodu"
	Grid(3, 2) = "Açýklama"
	Grid(4, 2) = "Operasyon"
	Grid(5, 2) = "Operasyon Adý"
	Grid(6, 2) = "Hmd. Miktari veya Tezgah Süresi"
	Grid(7, 2) = "Stok veya Tezgah Birimi"

	Grid(0, 4) = "C"
	Grid(1, 4) = "C"
	Grid(2, 4) = "C"
	Grid(3, 4) = "C"
	Grid(4, 4) = "C"
	Grid(5, 4) = "C"
	Grid(6, 4) = "N"
	Grid(7, 4) = "C"

End Sub

		SutunGenisligi = Grid(j,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(j,0)
		Degisken = trim(cstr(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		If Grid(j,4) = "N" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = 4
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 20,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(j,4) = "D" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
		End If
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, SatirYuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next					 
	xSatirNo = xSatirNo+1
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(8, 8)

	Grid(0, 0) = "XLEVEL"
	Grid(1, 0) = "BOMREC_SIRANO"
	Grid(2, 0) = "BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE"
	Grid(3, 0) = "ACIKLAMA"
	Grid(4, 0) = "BOMREC_OPERASYON"
	Grid(5, 0) = "BOMREC_OPERASYON_IMLT01_AD"
	Grid(6, 0) = "KAYNAKMIKTART"
	Grid(7, 0) = "KAYNAK_BIRIM"

	Grid(0, 1) = 11
	Grid(1, 1) = 10
	Grid(2, 1) = 40
	Grid(3, 1) = 70
	Grid(4, 1) = 20
	Grid(5, 1) = 70
	Grid(6, 1) = 20
	Grid(7, 1) = 15

	Grid(0, 2) = "Level"
	Grid(1, 2) = "Row No"
	Grid(2, 2) = "Source Code"
	Grid(3, 2) = "Statement"
	Grid(4, 2) = "Operation"
	Grid(5, 2) = "Operation Name"
	Grid(6, 2) = "Raw Material Quantity and Workbench Time"
	Grid(7, 2) = "Stock or Workbench Unit"

	Grid(0, 4) = "C"
	Grid(1, 4) = "C"
	Grid(2, 4) = "C"
	Grid(3, 4) = "C"
	Grid(4, 4) = "C"

End Sub

Public SayfaEni, SayfaBoyu, Yazildi
Sub PrintForm()
	Yazildi = 0
	Set pe1=doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	SayfaEni = 210
	SayfaBoyu = 297

	res=pe1.Open(0,"Mutabakat Mektubu",SayfaBoyu,SayfaEni,"")

	For i = 1 To TL_BORC_ALACAK.GetRecCount()
		If Doc.Is_EY1(TL_BORC_ALACAK.SELECTED(i)) Then
			Call DokumanYarat(pe1,i)
		End If
	Next    
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(0)
End Sub
Sub DokumanYarat(pe1,SatirNo)
	if Yazildi > 0 then res = pe1.PageBreak()
	UstMargin = 25
	SolMargin = 15
	SagMargin = sayfaEni - 10

	CHKodu = TL_BORC_ALACAK.KOD(satirNo)

	CHAdi1 = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,""))
	CHAdi2 = trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","NAME2",CHKodu,""))
	Adres1 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,"")
	Adres2 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,"")
	Adres3 = Doc.GetDbFieldValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,"")
	BorcAlacakTutari = TL_BORC_ALACAK.BORC_BAKIYESI(satirNo) - TL_BORC_ALACAK.ALACAK_BAKIYESI(satirNo)
	If BorcAlacakTutari > 0 Then
		BorcAlacak = "Borç Bakiyesi"
		AlacakBorc = "Alacak Bakiyesi"
	ElseIf BorcAlacakTutari = 0 Then
		BorcAlacak = "Bakiye"
	Else
		BorcAlacak = "Alacak Bakiyesi"
		AlacakBorc = "Borç Bakiyesi"
	End If
	BorcAlacakTutari1 = Doc.NumFormat0(Abs(BorcAlacakTutari),20,2)
	HazirlamaTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(Doc.BuGun())
	HesapTarihi = Doc.StrToNorDate(GLOBAL_STACK.HESAPTARIHIE(1))
	Firma = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")


	Icerik1 = "Ýþletmemizdeki cari hesabýnýz " + HesapTarihi + " tarihi itibarýyla " + BorcAlacakTutari1 + " " & Doc.DefaultPB & " "
	if BorcAlacakTutari = 0 Then
		Icerik2 = "Yalnýz Sýfýr YTL"
	Else
		Icerik2 = "Yalnýz " & Doc.NumToText_TL(Abs(BorcAlacakTutari))
	End if
	Icerik3 =	 Borcalacak + " vermektedir."
	Icerik4 = "Mutabýk olup olmadýðýmýzý bildirmenizi rica ederiz. Saygýlarýmýzla... "

	Not11 = "Mutabakat veya itirazýnýzý 1 (bir) ay içerisinde bildirmediðiniz takdirde"
	Not12 = "T.T.K. 92. maddesi gereði bakýyede mutabýk sayýlacaðýmýzý hatýrlatýrýz."
	Not21 = "Bakýyede mutabýk olmadýðýnýz takdirde bir hesap ekstrenizin gönderilmesini"
	Not22 = "rica ederiz. "
	Not23 = "HATA VE UNUTMA SAKLIDIR"
	Not24 = "Faks Numaramýz 212-876 58 26"

	Cevap11 = "Ýþletmemizdeki cari hesabýnýz " + HesapTarihi + " tarihi itibarýyla " + BorcAlacakTutari1 + " " + Doc.DefaultPB
	if BorcAlacakTutari = 0 Then
		Cevap12 = "Yalnýz Sýfýr YTL"
	Else
		Cevap12 = "Yalnýz " & Doc.NumToText_TL(Abs(BorcAlacakTutari))
	End if
	Cevap13 = AlacakBorc + " vermektedir."

	satirAra = 6

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin,SolMargin,5,150,CHAdi1)

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + satirAra,SolMargin,5,150,CHAdi2)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,150,Adres1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 3 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,150,Adres2)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 4 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,150,Adres3)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 6 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Icerik1)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 7 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Icerik2)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 8 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Icerik3)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 10 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Icerik4)

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 12 * satirAra,SolMargin + 16,5,10,"1 : ")

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 13 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not12)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 14 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not13)

	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 15 * satirAra,SolMargin + 16,5,10,"2 : ")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 15 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not21)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 16 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not22)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 17 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not23)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 18 * satirAra,SolMargin + 26,15,sagMargin - SolMargin - 26,Not24)


	res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 21 * satirAra,SagMargin-150,10,150,Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0"))
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")


	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 25 * satirAra,SolMargin,0,sagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + 25 * satirAra + 1,SolMargin,0,sagMargin - SolMargin)

	cBasla = UstMargin + 27 * satirAra
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Firma)
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla + satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Cevap11)
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla + 2 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Cevap12)
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla + 3 * satirAra,SolMargin,5,sagMargin - SolMargin,Cevap13)
	res = pe1.Write(cBasla + 6 * satirAra,SagMargin-50,5,30,"Kaþe - Ýmza")

	Yazildi = Yazildi + 1
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 4.2
	UstMargin = satiryuksekligi * 5
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 15
	SolMargin = 7
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 7
	'satiryuksekligi = 4.2
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + satiryuksekligi * 18
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 6 * SatirYuksekligi
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "LANDSCAPE")

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi

	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi + 2
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 7)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				Else
					If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
						Degisken = satirNo
					ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_AD" Then
						Kod = STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)
						if left(Kod,1) = "X" or left(Kod,2) = "ZZ" then
							degisken = STOK46T.NOTE0(satirNo)
						
						else
							degisken = STOK46T.KOD_STOK00_AD(satirNo)							
						end if
					Else
						Degisken = ""
					End If
				End If	
				res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
				
				If DegiskenAdi = "OR_FIYAT"  Then
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,4)

				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,2)

				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
				ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "SF_SF_UNIT"  Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

				ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "PRICEUNIT"  Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
				End If

				If DegiskenAdi= "NOTE0" Then
					if trim(Degisken) = "" Then
					'	KTA = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", STOK46T.KOD(satirNo), "SNOT", 0)
					'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr + satiryuksekligi, Solmargin + 9, satiryuksekligi, 120, "AÇIKLAMA :" & trim(KTA))
					Else
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr + satiryuksekligi-2, Solmargin + 9, satiryuksekligi, 120, "AÇIKLAMA :" & Degisken)
					End if
				Else
					res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(6,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(7,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(8,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(9,0) = "NOTE0"


	Grid(0,1) = 11
	Grid(1,1) = 30
	Grid(2,1) = 70
	Grid(3,1) = 25
	Grid(4,1) = 23
	Grid(5,1) = 15
	Grid(6,1) = 23
	Grid(7,1) = 20
	Grid(8,1) = 50
	Grid(9,1) = 0

	Grid(0,2) = "SIRA NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME TANIMI"
	Grid(3,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(4,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(5,2) = "BRM"
	Grid(6,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(7,2) = "PB"
	Grid(8,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(9,2) = "ACIKLAMA"

	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "D"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			if i=4 or i=5 then
				ondalik=2
			else
			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			end if
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(0,6) = 0
	dTutar = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM")
	dKDV = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVLERTOPLAM")
	dKDVDahil = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM")
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	satiryuksekligi = 4.2
	UstMargin = satiryuksekligi * 5
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 15
	SolMargin = 7
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 7
	'satiryuksekligi = 4.2
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + satiryuksekligi * 18
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 7 * SatirYuksekligi
	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "LANDSCAPE")

	Call Alanlar()
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = STOK46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 1
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			If satirNo = 1 Then
					satirpozr = satirBaslangic
			Else
					satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi + 2
			End If
			siraNo = siraNo + 1
		End If		
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 7)
		Sol = SolMargin + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
			For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
				SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
				DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
				If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					Degisken = trim(cstr(STOK46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
				Else
					If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
						Degisken = satirNo
					ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_AD" Then
						Kod = STOK46T.KOD(satirNo)
						if left(Kod,1) = "X" or left(Kod,2) = "ZZ" then
							degisken = STOK46T.NOTE0(satirNo)
						
						else
							degisken = STOK46T.KOD_STOK00_AD(satirNo)							
						end if
					Else
						Degisken = ""
					End If
				End If	
				res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
				
				If DegiskenAdi = "OR_FIYAT"  Then
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,4)

				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
					Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
					Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,2)

				ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
					Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
				ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
				ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "SF_SF_UNIT"  Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

				ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "PRICEUNIT"  Then
					res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
				End If

				If DegiskenAdi= "NOTE0" Then
					if trim(Degisken) = "" Then
					'	KTA = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK00", STOK46T.KOD(satirNo), "SNOT", 0)
					'	res = pe1.write(satirpozr + satiryuksekligi, Solmargin + 9, satiryuksekligi, 120, "AÇIKLAMA :" & trim(KTA))
					Else
						res = pe1.write(satirpozr + satiryuksekligi-2, Solmargin + 9, satiryuksekligi, 120, "AÇIKLAMA :" & Degisken)
					End if
				Else
					res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",8)
					res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 4, Degisken)
					res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",7)
				End If
				Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
				
			Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		
End Sub

Sub Alanlar()
	ReDim Grid(9,7)
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(5,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(6,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(7,0) = "PRICEUNIT"
	Grid(8,0) = "OR_TUTAR"
	Grid(9,0) = "NOTE0"


	Grid(0,1) = 11
	Grid(1,1) = 30
	Grid(2,1) = 70
	Grid(3,1) = 25
	Grid(4,1) = 23
	Grid(5,1) = 15
	Grid(6,1) = 23
	Grid(7,1) = 20
	Grid(8,1) = 50
	Grid(9,1) = 0

	Grid(0,2) = "SIRA NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "MALZEME KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME TANIMI"
	Grid(3,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(4,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(5,2) = "BRM"
	Grid(6,2) = "FÝYAT"
	Grid(7,2) = "PB"
	Grid(8,2) = "TUTAR"
	Grid(9,2) = "ACIKLAMA"

	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "D"
	Grid(4,4) = "N"
	Grid(5,4) = "C"
	Grid(6,4) = "N"
	Grid(7,4) = "C"
	Grid(8,4) = "N"
	Grid(9,4) = "C"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			if i=4 or i=5 then
				ondalik=2
			else
			ondalik = STOK46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			end if
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	
	Grid(0,6) = 0
	dTutar = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM")
	dKDV = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVLERTOPLAM")
	dKDVDahil = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM")
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 15
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 15
	satiryuksekligi = 6
'	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 64
	satirSonu = 280

	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	
	IsEmriNo = trim(MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1))
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ýþ Emri - " & IsEmriNo, SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	SatirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 4
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)
		If KaynakTipi = "I" Then
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
		End If
	Next
	satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom()
	'Call Hazirlayan(pe1,satirPozr)
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
        
'*******************
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
		FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")
		If trim(logo) <> "" Then
			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 3 ,SolMargin + 2, 10,120,logo,114)
		Else
			res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 3 ,SolMargin + 2, 6,120,FirmaAdi)
		End If
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		MPSRefNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)

		MamulKodu = MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU(1)
		MamulAdi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",MamulKodu,-1)
		UretimSipNo = MMPS10E.MUSTERISIPINO(1)
		GrupNo = MMPS10E.GRUPEVRAKNO(1)
		ToleransTipi = MMPS10E.TOLERANSTYPE(1)
		Tolerans = MMPS10E.TOLERANS(1)
		TeslimTarihi = Doc.StrtoNorDate(MMPS10E.URETIMDENTESTARIH(1))

		MamulMiktari = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR(1)
		Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(MamulMiktari)
		MamulMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(MamulMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	
		StokBirimi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",MamulKodu,-1)
		printt=doc.GetUDFValue("UP",MMPS10E.EVRAKNO,"TARIH",0)
		MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
		MusteriAdi = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",MusteriKodu,-1)
		MusteriAdi2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",MusteriKodu,-1)
		MusteriAdi = trim(MusteriAdi) & " " & trim(MusteriAdi2)
		Not1 = MMPS10E.NOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = MMPS10E.NOTLAR_2(1)

		bBasla = UstMargin+17
		SatirAra = 6
		
		
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"MPS Ref No")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,trim(MPSRefNo))

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 38,6,85,MamulKodu)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 2 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6, sagMargin - SolMargin - 38,MamulAdi)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Mamul Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36,6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,45,MamulMiktari & "  " & trim(StokBirimi))
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 3 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 85, 6,85,"(Tolerans : " & ToleransTipi & " % " & _
									Tolerans & ")")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Teslim Tarihi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 4 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,85,TeslimTarihi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Müþteri")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 5 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 38, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,MusteriAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 2, 6,33,"Notlar")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 36, 6,2,": ")
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 6 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 40, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,Not1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 7 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 40, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,Not2)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + 7 * SatirAra, SolMargin + 40, 6,SagMargin - SolMargin - 40,Not2)

		res = pe1.SetBold(2)
		res = pe1.Print(pe1.GetTop + SatirAra, SolMargin + 2,"Mühendislik Deðiþiklik Seviyesi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Print(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight + 1,": " & Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "SUPPLIERCODE", MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU,""))
		Alt = pe1.GetBottom()


		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, SolMargin + 100, 6,30,"Kalýp Baðlama")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla, pe1.GetRight, 6,40,": ")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, SolMargin + 100, 6,30,"Ayar Süresi")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(BBasla + SatirAra, pe1.GetRight, 6,40,": ")

		res = pe1.Line(Alt + 2, SolMargin,0,SagMargin - SolMargin)
		
		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(Alt + 4, SolMargin,6,SagMargin - SolMargin,"STANDART ÝÞ TANIMI")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)

		SatirAra = 4
		Set Tbl1 = GetSTCNTable()
		satirSayisi = Doc.Ceil(Tbl1.GetRowCount / 2)
		Basla = Alt + 4 + 2 * SatirAra
		EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom()
		For i = 1 to Tbl1.GetRowCount()
			satirPos = Basla + ((i - 1) mod satirSayisi) * satirAra
			if i <= satirSayisi Then
				sol = solMargin + 2
			Else
				sol = solMargin + 90
			End if
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, sol,6,55,Tbl1.NOTES(i))
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetLeft + 56,6,2,":")
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetLeft + 3,6,15,Tbl1.SF_MIKTAR(i))
			if pe1.GetBottom > EnAlt Then EnAlt = pe1.GetBottom
		Next

		res = pe1.Box(BBasla - 2, SolMargin, EnAlt - BBasla + 2,SagMargin - SolMargin)
		if Tbl1.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
			res = pe1.pensize(0.3)
			res = pe1.Line(Basla, SolMargin + 88,pe1.GetBottom - Basla,0)
		End if

		Basla1 = EnAlt + 2
		Dim Grid(6,1)
		Grid(0,0) = "Gün"
		Grid(1,0) = "Baþlama Saati"
		Grid(2,0) = "Bitiþ Saati"
		Grid(3,0) = "Üretilmesi Gereken"
		Grid(4,0) = "Hedef Üretim"
		Grid(5,0) = "Gerçekleþen Üretim"
		Grid(6,0) = "Açýklama"

		Grid(0,1) = 20
		Grid(1,1) = 20
		Grid(2,1) = 20
		Grid(3,1) = 20
		Grid(4,1) = 20
		Grid(5,1) = 25
		Grid(6,1) = 55

		res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		sol = solMargin + 1
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		For i = 0 to uBound(Grid,1)
			res = pe1.Write(Basla1, sol, 10, Grid(i,1) - 2, Grid(i,0))
			sol = sol + Grid(i,1)
		Next
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)

		GunlukUretimMiktari = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00", "B_MINIMUMSIPMIKTARI", MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU, "")
		if GunlukUretimMiktari = 0 Then GunlukUretimMiktari = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR
		Kalan = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR

		sBasla = pe1.GetBottom()
		Aralik1 = 5
		j = 0
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		Set d7Date = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
		Gun = MMPS10E.REVURETIMDENTESTARIH
		Do
			j = j + 1
			satirPos = sBasla + (j - 1) * Aralik1
			sol = solMargin + 1
			d7Date.SetDate Gun
			d7Date.Increment -1
			if d7Date.GetDOW = 7 Then d7Date.Increment -1
			Gun = d7Date.GetRevDate()
			if Kalan < GunlukUretimMiktari Then
				UretilmesiGereken = Kalan
			Else
				UretilmesiGereken = GunlukUretimMiktari
			End if
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, solMargin + 1, 5, Grid(0,1) - 2, Doc.StrToNorDate(Gun))
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, pe1.GetRight + 2, 5, Grid(1,1) - 2, "08:00")
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, pe1.GetRight + 2, 5, Grid(2,1) - 2, "20:00")
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, pe1.GetRight + 2, 5, Grid(3,1) - 2, UretilmesiGereken)
			res = pe1.Write(satirPos, pe1.GetRight + 2, 5, Grid(4,1) - 2, GunlukUretimMiktari)

			Kalan = Kalan - GunlukUretimMiktari
		Loop While Kalan > 0
		satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom + 2

		res = pe1.Box(Basla1 - 1, solMargin, pe1.GetBottom - Basla1 + 1, sagMargin - solMargin)
		cizgiBoyu = pe1.GetBottom - pe1.GetTop
		KutuUst = pe1.GetTop
		res = pe1.Line(sBasla - 1, solMargin, 0, sagMargin - solMargin)
		sol = solMargin
		For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1) - 1
			sol = sol + Grid(i,1)
			res = pe1.Line(KutuUst, sol, cizgiBoyu, 0)
		Next
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")		

		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
'sss
	If trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)

	Ekler = SatirSatir(SatirNo) + Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) + MesajSatir(SatirNo) + HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom() + Ekler
	
	If sonSatir >= satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
'		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = UstMargin + 6
	Else
		If SiraNo = 0 Then
				satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
				satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + satiryuksekligi
'				satirpozr = SatirBaslangic + siraNo * satiryuksekligi
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		

	satirBas = satirPozr

	TezgahKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	TezgahAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",TezgahKodu,-1)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	OperasyonAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OperasyonKodu,-1)
	YMMiktari = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULMIKTAR(SatirNo)
	Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(YMMiktari)
	YMMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(YMMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	OperasyonSuresi = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(SatirNo)


	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.Box(SatirPozr, SolMargin,7,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr + 1, SolMargin,5,SagMargin - SolMargin,trim(TezgahAdi))
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi + 2

	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 2,5,28,"Ýþ Merkezi")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 30,5,100,": " & trim(TezgahKodu) & " - " & trim(TezgahAdi))
	If trim(OperasyonKodu) <> "" Then
		satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 2,5,28,"Operasyon")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 30,5,65,": " & OperasyonAdi)

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 105,5,23,"Ayar Süresi")
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 129,5,3,":")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 132,5,15,AyarSuresi)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 149,5,12,"SAAT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr - SatirYuksekligi, SolMargin + 161,5,30,"..............")

		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 105,5,23,"Oper. Süresi")
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 129,5,3,":")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 132,5,15,OperasyonSuresi)
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 149,5,12,"SAAT")
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 161,5,30,"..............")

		satirPozr = pe1.GetTop() + SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.Write(satirPozr, SolMargin + 2,5,28,"Üretim Miktarý")
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr, SolMargin + 30,5,65,": " & YMMiktari)
	End If
	rSiraNo = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(SatirNo)
	SatirSon = pe1.GetBottom()

	SatirPozr = SatirPozr + 2.5

	Call MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	Call MesajYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
	Call HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
	SatirSon = SatirSon + Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo) + MesajSatir(SatirNo) + 2

	HammaddeSon = SatirSon + HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) + 2
	
'xxx
	res = pe1.Box(SatirBas ,SolMargin,SatirSon - SatirBas,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	If HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo) > 0 Then
		res = pe1.Box(SatirSon,SolMargin,HammaddeSon - SatirSon,SagMargin - SolMargin)
	End If
' amman dikkat bu satýr önemli! ***********
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom() - 2,2,3,5,"")
'******************************************

End Sub
Function SatirSatir(satirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)

	If trim(OperasyonKodu) <> "" Then
		k = 4
	Else 
		k = 2
	End If
	satirSatir = k * SatirYuksekligi
End Function
Sub MesajYaz(pe1,SatirPozr, SatirNo)
'mmm
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","UP**"+MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")
	For i = 1 To rows
		MesajKodu = Old.KOD(i)
		If trim(MesajKodu) = "FILE" Then
			Dosya = Old.Notes(i)
			If i = 1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirPozr() + Satiryuksekligi
			Else
				satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2
			End If
			res = pe1.StoreSet(1)
			res = pe1.NoPen()
			res = pe1.Picture(SatirPozr, Solmargin + 30, 50,120,"..\wd\images\" & trim(Dosya),114)
			res = pe1.UseSet(1)
		Else
			If i = 1 Then
				satirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
			Else
				satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom() + 2
			End If
			Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i) 
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 30, 5,120,Mesaj)
		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function MesajSatir(SatirNo)
'mmm
	rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","UP**"+MMPS10T.JOBNO(SatirNo)+Space(6))
	Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")
	For i = 1 To rows
		MesajKodu = Old.KOD(i)
		If trim(MesajKodu) = "FILE" Then
			k = k + 55
		Else
			k = k + SatirYuksekligi
		End If
	Next
	MesajSatir = k
End Function
Sub MuhendislikTanimiYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, SatirNo)
'ttt
'	Doc.Tech10_select(mamulkodu,yarimamulkodu,kaynaktype,kaynakkodu,operasyon,musterikodu,mpsno)
	MamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)
	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")
	SatirSayisi = Tech.GetRecCount()
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Courier New",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		Tanim = Tech.TSTEXT(i)		
		satirPozr = satirPozr + Satiryuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 30, 5,SagMargin - SolMargin - 32,Tanim)
	Next
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
End Sub
Function Muhendisliksatir(SatirNo)
'ttt
'	Doc.Tech10_select(mamulkodu,yarimamulkodu,kaynaktype,kaynakkodu,operasyon,musterikodu,mpsno)
	MamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_MAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	YariMamulKodu = MMPS10T.R_YMAMULKODU(SatirNo)
	KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(SatirNo)
	KaynakKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(SatirNo)
	OperasyonKodu = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(SatirNo)
	MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
	MPSNo = MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1)
	
	res = Doc.Tech10_Select(MamulKodu, YariMamulKodu, KaynakTipi, KaynakKodu, OperasyonKodu,MusteriKodu,MPSNo)

	Set Tech = Doc.GetTableObject("_TECH10T_SELECT")

	MuhendislikSatir = Tech.GetRecCount() * SatirYuksekligi

End Function
Sub HammaddeYaz(pe1, SatirPozr, rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			SatirPozr = SatirPozr + Satiryuksekligi

			HammaddeKodu = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(i)
			HammaddeAdi = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",HammaddeKodu,-1)
			HammaddeMiktari = MMPS10T.R_MIKTART(i)
			HammaddeMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(HammaddeMiktari,18,Doc.SigDig(HammaddeMiktari))
			HammaddeBirim = Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",HammaddeKodu,-1)
		
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 2, 5,40,HammaddeKodu)
			res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 44, 5,87,HammaddeAdi)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 132, 5,15,HammaddeMiktari)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 149, 5,12,Hammaddebirim)
		'	res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,"..............")
			res = pe1.Write(SatirPozr,Solmargin + 161, 5,30,Doc.Stok00c_SonMik(HammaddeKodu,"YMM"))

			res = pe1.setbold(0)
			res=pe1.selectfont("arial",8)
			res = pe1.write(ustMargin+270,10,-2,50,"03 FRM 004")

		End If
	Next
End Sub
Function HammaddeSatir(rSiraNo)
'hhh
	SatirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For i = 1 To SatirSayisi
		rSiraNo1 = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(i)
		If rSiraNo1 = rSiraNo And 	trim(MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)) = "H"  Then
			n = n + 1
		End If
	Next
	HammaddeSatir = n * SatirYuksekligi
End Function

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
'SAS
	Alt = pe1.GetBottom()
	
End Sub
Sub Hazirlayan(pe1,SatirPozr)
	If (satirPozr + 30) > satirSonu Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		satirPozr = UstMargin + 6
	End If
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,SolMargin,6,(SagMargin-SolMargin) / 2, "HAZIRLAYAN")
	res = pe1.Write(satirPozr + 5,(SagMargin+SolMargin) / 2,6,(SagMargin-SolMargin) / 2, "ONAYLAYAN")
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Line(satirPozr + 3,(SagMargin+SolMargin) / 2,30,0)
	res = pe1.Line(satirPozr + 12,SolMargin,0,SagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Box(satirPozr + 3,SolMargin,30,SagMargin-SolMargin)
End Sub
Sub SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	For i = 1 To SayfaSayisi
		res = pe1.GotoPage(i)
		If i = 1 Then
			res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin + 10, SagMargin - 30, 6,30, "\b Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & SayfaSayisi)
		Else
			res = pe1.WriteRTF(UstMargin , SagMargin - 30, 6,30, "\b Sayfa  :  \b0 " & i & "  /  " & SayfaSayisi)
		End If
	Next
End Sub

Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
Function ParlaticiYaz(pKod)
	For i = 1 To Len(cStr(pKod))
		If i = 1 Then
			Parlatici = pAdi(mid(cStr(pKod),i,1))
		Else
			Parlatici = Parlatici & ", " & pAdi(mid(cStr(pKod),i,1)	)
		End If
	Next
    ParlaticiYaz = Parlatici
End Function
Function pAdi(pKod)
	Select Case pKod
		Case 2
			pAdi = "DÝSP"
		Case 3
			pAdi = "SOLV"
		Case 4
			pAdi = "UV"
		Case 6
			pAdi = "BLIST"
		Case 7
			pAdi = "PRIMER"
		Case 8
			pAdi = "S.TATB"
		Case 9
			pAdi = "VÝKOLÝT"
	End Select
End Function
Function GetSTCNTable()
	TablStr = "xxwewfwfsf"
	Doc.CreateTableObject TablStr & "=STOK40T", "TMPCOPY"  
	Set GetSTCNTable = Doc.GetTableObject(TablStr)
	Set S00 = Doc.Select1("wefwefrwe", "STOK00", "KOD='" & MMPS10E.MAMULSTOKKODU & "'", "", -1)
	For i = 1 to 25
		BBTech = S00.GetFieldValue("B_B_TECH_" & i, 1)
		If Doc.DRound(BBTech) > 0 Then
			satirNo = GetSTCNTable.AddRow
			StokTekN = Doc.Customp_Gets("STCN" & Right("00" & i,2))
			StokTekN = replace(StokTekN,":","")
			GetSTCNTable.NOTES(satirNo) = StokTekN
			GetSTCNTable.SF_MIKTAR(satirNo) = Doc.DRound(BBTech)
		End If
	Next
End Function

Sub PrintLabel()
	Call STOKRESIM_YAZ() '////////// STOK KARTI RESÝM TABINDAN EXCELE LÝSTE

Sub STOKRESIM_YAZ()

	Dim k,Wb,Sheet

'***********************************************
	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
'************************************************
	k.Visible = True
	satir = 2
	KolonYaz = 0
	Sayac = 1 
	'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","LISTET")
	For i = 1 To LISTET.GetRecCount()
		'LÝSTE TABINDAKÝ GÖRÜNEN KOLON BAÞLIKLARINA GÖRE GRÝDLERÝN NOLARINI YAZ
		Baslik_StokKodu 	= Grid(4,2)
		Baslik_StokAd1		= Grid(5,2)
		Baslik_StokAd2		= Grid(6,2)
		Baslik_FasonKodu	= Grid(3,2)
		Baslik_FasonDurumu	= Grid(17,2)
		'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		If KolonYaz = 0 Then
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	1).Value = "S.No"
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	2).Value = "Resim"
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	3).Value = Trim(Baslik_StokKodu )
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	4).Value = Trim(Baslik_StokAd1)
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	5).Value = Trim(Baslik_StokAd2)	
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	6).Value = Trim(Baslik_FasonKodu)	
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir,	7).Value = Trim(Baslik_FasonDurumu	)	
		End If
		'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLON BASLIK ALAN ADINI GRID(4,0) OLARAK YAZDIRIP SATIR DEGERLERÝNÝ ALABÝLÝRÝZ.
		Deger_StokKodu	 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(4,0),	i)
		Deger_StokKodu 	= Doc.LeftJustify(Deger_StokKodu, 24)
		Deger_StokAd1	 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(5,0),	i)
		Deger_StokAd2	 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(6,0),	i)
		Deger_FasonKodu 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(3,0), i)
		Deger_FasonDurumu 	= LISTET.GetFieldValue(Grid(17,0), i)
		'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'RESÝM AL
		Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & Deger_StokKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
		'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
		If S0P1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
			Set S0P = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK0P")
			Doc.Load_Voucher Deger_StokKodu
			S0P.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
			ResimAl = Trim(S0P.FULLFILENAME1(1))
			Doc.Save_Voucher
			Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
		End If
		Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & Deger_StokKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
		ResimAl = Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
		Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & ResimAl
		If Resim1 <> "" THEN
			Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir+1, 2).rowheight = Wb.Sheets(1).cells(satir+1,2).rowheight*2.5
			rtop = Wb.Sheets(1).cells(satir+1, 2).Top+1.5
			rleft= Wb.Sheets(1).cells(satir+1, 2).Left+1.5
			Wb.Sheets(1).cells(satir+1, 2).Select
			Set resim = Wb.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(resim1)) 
			resimadi=resim.Name
			wb.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
			resim.Left = rleft 
			resim.Top = rtop
  		
			k.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  			k.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
  			k.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45
		End If
		'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SATIRLARA DATALARI YAZDIRMA
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	1).Value = Sayac
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	3).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_StokKodu)
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	4).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_StokAd1)
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	5).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_StokAd2)
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	6).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_FasonKodu)
		Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(satir + 1,	7).Value = "'" & Trim(Deger_FasonDurumu)
		'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		KolonYaz = 1
		Satir = Satir + 1
		Sayac=Sayac+1
	Next
	SONSATIR = SATIR
	SONKOLON = 7

		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(SONSATIR, SONKOLON)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim ExcelApp, Wb1
	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add

	satir = 5
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")

	FOR i = 1 TO MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
	
		satir = satir + 1
	
		IF TRIM(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 THEN

			satir = satir + 1
			MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "", -1)
			Resim1= trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.GetFieldValue("FULLFILENAME1", 1))
		
		ELSE 

			MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
		
			IF LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="YM" THEN

				Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "", -1)
				Resim1= trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.GetFieldValue("FULLFILENAME1", 1))
		
				IF TRIM(S0P.GetFieldValue("FULLFILENAME1", 1))="" THEN

					Resim1=	Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\RESIMCEK.jpg" 

				END IF
					
			ELSEIF LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),1)="Y" THEN

				Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "", -1)
				Resim1= trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.GetFieldValue("FULLFILENAME1", 2))

			ELSE 
				
				Resim1=""

			END IF

		END IF

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				
		IF Resim1 <> "" THEN

			Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight*2.5

			rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Top+1.5
								
			rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Left+1.5

			Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 

			resimadi=resim.name
				
			wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
    
			resim.Left = rleft 
			resim.Top = rtop
    		
			ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  			ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
  			ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45

		END IF

			For j = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)

				if Grid(j,1) > 0 Then

					AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
					Deger = MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)

						if Grid(j,4) = "C" Then

							Deger = "'" & Deger
							Deger = Trim(deger)

						End if

					Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,j + 2).Value = Deger
		
				End if

			Next

	NEXT

 	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(4).RowHeight = 49.5

	For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)

		baslik = Replace(Grid(i,2),"\n", " ")
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+1).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		'ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 45
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+2).Value = trim(baslik)
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(i + 2).autofit

	Next

	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select

	Set Wb1 = Nothing
	Set ExcelApp = Nothing



End Sub

SUB PrintForm()

	Dim pe1
	SAYFABOYU 			=	297

	ISEMRIENALTKONUM	= 21

		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & Doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

'-------------------------------------------- MALZEME TAKÝP FORMU ---------------------------------------------------
Sub PRINT_FORM_SATIRT(pe1,i)

	p=4.5
	ff=3.7
	w=12
	r=21
	h=16
	u=15
	SATIRBAS=12
	SATIRPOZR1=66
	If m<>1 Then res=pe1.PageBreak()
		'MALZEME TAKÝP FORMUNUN DIÞ KUTUSUNU ÇÝZER
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.4)
	res = pe1.Box(5, 5, 259, SAGSINIR-2.5)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
		'MALZEME TAKÝP FORMUNUN SOLUNDAKÝ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SATIRBAS-7,SOLMARGIN+35,12,0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 15)	
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.Write(SATIRBAS-4, SOLMARGIN+55, 12,100,"MALZEME TAKÝP FORMU (GÜNLÜK)")	
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 7) 
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
		'MALZEME TAKÝP FORMUNUN SAÐINDAKÝ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SATIRBAS-7,SOLMARGIN+176.5,12,0)
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	res=pe1.picture(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 12, 12, RESIM_Y_MAMUL, 0)	
	res=pe1.picture(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight, 12, 12, RESIM_MAMUL, 0)	
	SOLEK=0.2
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.4)
		'MALZEME TAKÝP FORMUNUN ALTINDAKÝ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SATIRBAS+5, SOLMARGIN+SOLEK, 0, SAGSINIR-3)	
	res = pe1.NoPen()

	ALTSONSATIR=pe1.GetBottom()
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",7)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	res = pe1.Write(SATIRBAS+w-2.7, SOLMARGIN+0.2, ff, 8.3, "OP.NO")
	OPNOSAGKONUM= pe1.GetRight
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.Write(SATIRBAS+w-2.7, pe1.GetRight+0.2, ff, 90.1, "OPERASYON ADI")
	OPADISAGKONUM= pe1.GetRight
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	res = pe1.Write(SATIRBAS+w-2.7, pe1.GetRight+0.2, ff, 101.5, "TEZGAH NO ve ADI")
	TEZGAHADISAGKONUM= pe1.GetRight
		'JOBNO 
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")
	'res = pe1.Write(SATIRBAS+w-2.7, pe1.GetRight+0.2, ff, 65, "JOBNO ve BARKODU")
	res = pe1.SetAlign("Left")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)

	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
	res = pe1.Nopen()
	res = pe1.Picture(6, SOLMARGIN+2.5, 10, 30, LOGO, 0)
  	res = pe1.SetAlign("Center")

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
		'OP.NO ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SATIRBAS+w+1, SOLMARGIN+SOLEK, 0, SAGSINIR-3)
		'MALZEME TAKÝP FORMUNDAKÝ OPERASYON ADI
	SATIRSAY = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	For OPSAY = 1 To SATIRSAY
		KAYNAKTIPI = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(OPSAY)
		IF KAYNAKTIPI = "I" Then
			TEZGAHKODU = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKKODU(OPSAY)
			TEZGAHADI = Doc.GetKartValue("IMLT00","AD",TEZGAHKODU ,-1)
			OPERASYONKODU = MMPS10T.R_OPERASYON(OPSAY)
			OPERASYONADI = Doc.GetKartValue("IMLT01","AD",OPERASYONKODU ,-1)
			
			If Trim(OPERASYONKODU ) <> "" Then
				res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",8)
				res = pe1.SetBold(0)
				OPNO = MMPS10T.R_SIRANO(OPSAY)		
				'OP_IS_NO = Trim(MMPS10T.JOBNO(OPSAY))
				res = pe1.SetAlign("Right") 
				res = pe1.Write(SATIRBAS+w+2+ASA, SOLMARGIN-4, ff, 10, OPNO)
					'OP NO SAÐI DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
				res = pe1.Line(SATIRBAS+4.6+p, OPNOSAGKONUM, p+pp+4.4, 0)

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	
	ToplamEn = 0
	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 15
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 15
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 15
	satiryuksekligi = 6
'	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 64
	satirSonu = 280

	ReDim xCizgi(1)
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	
	IsEmriNo = trim(MMPS10E.EVRAKNO(1))
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Ýþ Emri - " & IsEmriNo, SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        
	satirSayisi = MMPS10T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	SatirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom() + 4
	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		KaynakTipi = MMPS10T.R_KAYNAKTYPE(i)
		If KaynakTipi = "I" Then
			Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i)
		End If
	Next
	satirPozr = pe1.GetBottom()
	'Call Hazirlayan(pe1,satirPozr)
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	Call SayfaSayisiYazdir(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		res = pe1.nopen()
        
'*******************
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
		res = pe1.SetBold(1)
		res = pe1.NoPen()
		logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
		FirmaAdi = Doc.Customp_Gets("FNAMEL0")

			res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin + 3 ,SolMargin + 2, 10,120,logo,114)
		Else
			res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 3 ,SolMargin + 2, 6,120,FirmaAdi)
		End If

		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 10)

		Tolerans = MMPS10E.TOLERANS(1)
		TeslimTarihi = Doc.StrtoNorDate(MMPS10E.URETIMDENTESTARIH(1))

		MamulMiktari = MMPS10E.SF_TOPLAMMIKTAR(1)
		Ondalik = Doc.SigDig(MamulMiktari)
		MamulMiktari = Doc.NumFormat(MamulMiktari,18,Ondalik)
	
		StokBirimi = doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","IUNIT",MamulKodu,-1)
		printt=doc.GetUDFValue("UP",MMPS10E.EVRAKNO,"TARIH",0)
		MusteriKodu = MMPS10E.MUSTERIKODU(1)
		MusteriAdi = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",MusteriKodu,-1)
		MusteriAdi2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","NAME2",MusteriKodu,-1)
		MusteriAdi = trim(MusteriAdi) & " " & trim(MusteriAdi2)
		Not1 = MMPS10E.NOTLAR_1(1)
		Not2 = MMPS10E.NOTLAR_2(1)
